channel.title: Ali Welekhasia | Gospel Music, Crusades & Devotionals Feed
channel.description: Official RSS feed of Ali Welekhasia. Stay updated with new Swahili worship releases, upcoming open-air gospel crusades, weekly devotionals, and ministry highlights.

item.title: Upcoming Crusade: 3-Day Open Grounds Gospel Crusade - Nakuru
item.description: Join Evangelist Ali Welekhasia and the ministry team at Afraha Grounds, Nakuru for three power-packed days of salvation, healing, deliverance, and intense praise worship.

item.title: Devotional: The Unstoppable Power of Unwavering Faith
item.description: Hebrews 11:1 reminds us that faith is the assurance of things hoped for. When facing impossible walls, faith anchors our spirit in God's eternal promises.

item.title: Devotional: Deepening Your Secret Place of Worship
item.description: True worship is an intimate surrender that begins when no spotlight is shining. Discover practical ways to cultivate a vibrant daily prayer altar.

item.title: Devotional: Enduring the Storm with Joy & Patience
item.description: Inspired by the song 'Vumilia Moyo', explore how biblical perseverance transforms trials into enduring faith and spiritual authority.

item.title: Music Release: Ni Wewe (Live Worship Experience)
item.description: Experience the anointed live recording of 'Ni Wewe' featuring chord progressions, Swahili lyrics, and English translations.
